content.value_statement: Large markdown plans are hard for agent teams to execute consistently. This skill turns plans into detailed Beads tasks with dependencies, review loops, and handoff guidance.
actual_capabilities: Provides prompts for converting long markdown plans into self-contained Beads tasks.
Defines repeated polishing prompts for improving task scope, context, dependencies, and test coverage.
Includes a bead quality checklist covering scope, dependencies, tests, and feature preservation.
Shows Beads CLI and Beads Viewer robot-mode command examples for agent workflows.
Describes Agent Mail conventions that connect bead IDs to threads and file reservations.
limitations: Does not install or implement the Beads CLI, Beads Viewer, or Agent Mail tools.
Requires users to replace sample filenames and bead IDs with their project values.
Provides workflow guidance, not automated validation of generated beads.
Assumes the user has a project plan that is ready for task decomposition.

use_cases.title: Convert a Long Plan
use_cases.description: Turn a detailed markdown implementation plan into task beads with dependencies, background, and success criteria.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Agent Work
use_cases.description: Prepare dependency-aware tasks that multiple coding agents can pick up with less missing context.

use_cases.title: Plan Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Create dedicated beads for unit tests, integration tests, e2e scripts, and review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Create First Beads
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner conversion from one markdown plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read my markdown plan and convert it into self-contained Beads tasks. Include dependencies, background, success criteria, and test expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Polish Existing Beads
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review after initial task creation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current beads for missing context, unclear scope, weak dependencies, and missing tests. Revise the beads before implementation starts.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Agent Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced coordination for parallel coding agents.
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize the beads so agents can work in parallel. Identify blockers, ready work, file coordination needs, and communication threads.

prompt_templates.title: Run Final Cross-Model Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a final review of the bead graph. Look for dependency cycles, missing tests, lost requirements, and tasks that need more implementation detail.

output_examples.input: A product plan for adding OAuth login, account linking, and session management.
output_examples.output: A set of implementation beads covering the user model, provider setup, token handling, session flow, protected routes, and related tests.

output_examples.input: A completed bead list that needs review before agents begin coding.
output_examples.output: A review summary that flags missing dependencies, unclear acceptance criteria, weak test coverage, and tasks that need richer context.

output_examples.input: A project with multiple agents working from Beads and Agent Mail.
output_examples.output: A coordination plan that maps bead IDs to ready work, blocked work, file reservations, and communication threads.

best_practices: Replace all sample filenames, bead IDs, and project examples before using the prompts.
Polish beads repeatedly until scope, dependencies, and tests stop changing in meaningful ways.
Use robot-friendly Beads Viewer modes when an agent needs task graph information.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before dependencies, test scope, and acceptance criteria are reviewed.
Creating short beads that require agents to reread the original markdown plan.
Using interactive Beads Viewer mode inside automated agent workflows.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps convert markdown implementation plans into detailed Beads tasks with dependencies and review guidance.

faq.question: Does it create beads automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides prompts and workflow steps for an agent or user to create beads with the Beads CLI.

faq.question: Which tools does it assume?
faq.answer: It assumes Beads CLI, Beads Viewer, and optional Agent Mail are available in the user environment.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes prompts intended for Claude Code and other coding agents that can use Beads tools.

faq.question: Can Codex use this workflow?
faq.answer: Yes. Codex can use the workflow to review plans, improve beads, and prepare implementation handoffs.

faq.question: What should users review before implementation?
faq.answer: Users should review bead scope, dependency links, acceptance criteria, test coverage, and missing plan details.
